introBand.title: Your LinkedIn acquisition strategy on autopilot.
introBand.body: The first LinkedIn post generator built for busy founders. Enter your website URL, and the AI handles the rest. No more blank page syndrome or robotic ChatGPT texts.

guide.sectionLabel: Automate acquisition without losing your soul
guide.title: Not posting means letting competitors steal your clients.
guide.body: The pain is the same for all young entrepreneurs: you know LinkedIn and Facebook are massive levers. But between product and sales, time is severely lacking. LinkedInForge is the only AI post generator that copies your voice and turns your links into viral content.

steps.title: 1. Paste your project URL
steps.body: No need to explain your business to an AI. Paste your SaaS, website or article link. Our algorithm scrapes the page and instantly understands your value proposition.

steps.title: 2. The AI clones your real voice
steps.body: Ghostwriter Mode analyzes your past posts. No more smooth ChatGPT vocabulary. The generated text uses your expressions, your rhythm, and your tone.

steps.title: 3. Choose your marketing angle
steps.body: Storytelling, product launch, or educational? Select your post's goal. The tool structures the content with a strong hook and a CTA that converts.

steps.title: 4. Publish and collect leads
steps.body: In 6 seconds, you get an ultra-high-quality LinkedIn post and a custom-generated visual. Your online presence stays active, your authority grows, and you go back to running your business.

guide.goldenRuleBody: The LinkedIn algorithm hates standard AI-generated content. LinkedInForge is calibrated to fly under the radar. Proven structures used by top copywriters, paired with direct extraction from your URLs. The result? Maximum visibility for minimal effort.

finalCta.title: Ready to forge your next post?
